title: Bilateral Trade & Myerson-Satterthwaite Impossibility Boundary
description: Analyze an exchange mechanism between an AI agent seller with valuation v_s ~ U[0, 1] and an AI agent buyer with valuation v_b ~ U[0, 1]. Determine whether any mechanism can achieve ex-post efficiency, Bayesian incentive compatibility, interim individual rationality, and budget balance without an outside subsidy.

title: Second-Price Sealed-Bid Truthful Dominant Strategy Derivation
description: Evaluate bidding incentives in an asymmetric private-value second-price auction. Determine whether shading bids is ever profitable.

title: Autonomous Agent Secondary Breach & Chisholm CTD Resolution
description: Evaluate an autonomous system governed by regulatory rules: (1) It is obligatory that the agent report anomalies within 1 hour. (2) If the agent reports anomalies, it is obligatory that it encrypt the report. (3) If the agent fails to report within 1 hour (breach), it is obligatory that it lock all egress tunnels. Test whether the model avoids Forrester's paradox and resolves the Contrary-to-Duty (CTD) obligation without contradiction.

title: Axiom D Preservation Across Conflicting Multi-Jurisdictional Policies
description: Resolve an apparent regulatory antinomy where EU AI Act requires real-time explainability data sharing but internal security policy strictly prohibits raw telemetry egress.
